captions.detailed: A 3D-printable cylindrical container set consisting of a slip-fit cap and a base, both featuring rounded, dome-like closed ends. The shorter cap section includes a small, integrated loop at its dome tip for attaching a strap or keyring. The taller base section is designed to slide snugly into the cap, creating a secure, capsule-shaped protective enclosure.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, two-part cylindrical container consisting of a base and a slip-fit cap with a strap loop on top. Provide adjustments for inside diameter, wall thickness, heights of both parts, fit tolerance, and loop dimensions.
captions.factory: The model consists of two main modules: geoMicroLid and geoMicroBase. Both modules construct their outer cylindrical shells by using hull() on a sphere and a cylinder to create a smooth, domed cap. The inner cavities are hollowed out using a similar hull() of smaller spheres and cylinders, subtracted via difference(). A small loop is added to the lid using subtracted concentric rotated cylinders, and a tapered entry bevel is subtracted from the open ends of both parts using cylinders with mismatched r1 and r2 values.
